title: Slumbering Essence
description: If this card is in your hand at the end of turn, reduce its cost by 1 until it is played.
notes: The cost reduction is applied via AddUntilPlayed(-1) each turn the card remains in hand at end of turn (BeforeFlush). The cost decreases by 1 per turn it stays unplayed, and resets when the card is played. No current sources (events or relics) apply this enchantment in v0.107.1.
